messages:
deploybot: Preflight report for release v2.4.0 -> v2.4.0+1: prompt-suite regression detected. Failure-rate delta = +3.2% (threshold 2.0%). Action: HOLD promotion for canary and run focused samples. Report: https://ci/reports/PR-4821
maya: ACK. thanks for the flag. can someone grab the sample diffs?
jonathan: looking now. initial eyeball shows hallucination uptick on long-form summarizer prompts, also some off-by-one token outputs.
qa-bot: attaching 5 failing examples from the suite:
```
1) input: long meeting notes...
   baseline: correct summary
   candidate: invents new attendee
2) input: conversation about billing
   baseline: correct entities
   candidate: drops critical billing line
```
sara: these failures look clustered around longer contexts. could be changed tokenization / kv-cache align shifts after the attention tweak.
tony: decision time: pin older model or attempt a hotfix in the release? hotfix might be risky inside the window. thoughts?
jonathan: hotfix risk high for release-weekend. recommend pin canary to v2.3.1, continue bisect + fix in parallel. keep non-critical traffic on new build if possible.
maya: propose: pin canary only (not full rollback), 3h hold window, run full focused-suite after bisect. if QA signoff -> unpin and continue. if not -> escalate to rollback.
tony: sounds good. please file the pin change in the release notes and call it out in the change window. i'll sign off once pin action recorded.
deploybot: Action: pinned canary route to model v2.3.1 for 3 hours (pin_id: pin-3075-01). Notifying autoscaler and routing.
jonathan: thanks. starting bisect job now, will run narrow tests against quant/attention flags and log diffs to the bisect runbook. looping in infra.
sre-oncall: bisect runner started (run-3075-bisect). ETA ~25m for first pass.
maya: QA, please rerun the focused sample sweep after first bisect pass and post results here.
sara: on it. will post results in ~30m.
jonathan: if bisect narrows to quant change, i can prepare a targeted revert build to test quickly.
maya: good. keep updates short here. @tony i'll need your explicit unpin approval or rollback decision after QA.
tony: noted. ready to approve unpin if delta < 1.5% and no semantic regressions in samples.
qa-bot: focused-suite first pass: delta down to +1.1% (within threshold). detailed samples: 2/250 failures, both in long-form.
sara: confirming samples look marginal, not total breakage. i'll re-run longer sweep and attach diffs.
maya: :thumbsup: provisional unpin depends on the longer sweep. thanks team.
deploybot: Update: focused-suite full sweep still at +1.0% delta. HOLD remains until manual QA signoff.
jonathan: i'll prepare canary unpin PR and smoke test plan.
sara: QA signoff pending final diffs. will post a short summary in 20m.
maya: thanks all — keeping this thread for the approval chain.
deploybot: Log: pin-3075-01 active, will auto-expire after 3h unless extended.
